title: The Broken Hardys: deletion, decay & rebirth
summary: Matt Hardy’s transformation turns a bitter feud with Jeff into a surreal family saga. The brothers pass through the Final Deletion, reunite against Decay and reclaim the tag-team championship.

chapters.title: Jeff wins Full Metal Mayhem
chapters.result: Jeff Hardy defeats his transformed brother Matt.
chapters.context: The violent match deepens Matt’s obsession with eliminating Jeff’s identity, setting up a fight on the Hardy family’s own ground.

chapters.title: The Final Deletion
chapters.result: Matt defeats Jeff at the Hardy compound.
chapters.context: The filmed confrontation replaces a conventional arena match with fireworks, family mythology and the threat of deletion. Jeff’s defeat begins his Brother Nero chapter.

chapters.title: Delete or Decay
chapters.result: The Hardys defend their compound against Decay.
chapters.context: Matt and Jeff now stand together as Decay brings the feud to their home. The family setting and supernatural presentation carry the story beyond the ring.

chapters.title: The Great War brings tag-team gold
chapters.result: The Broken Hardys defeat Decay for the tag titles.
chapters.context: A match combining filmed action and an arena finish pays off the brothers’ reunion. The broken family has become a championship team.
